Brown County WebTrac. The 24 even-numbered 30-amp sites (2-46 and 266) are first-come, first-served, with availability posted on the county page; all other sites are online-reservable only. Online minimums: 2 nights for Friday-Saturday, 3 on Memorial, Independence and Labor Day. A camper or tent must be on a first-come site the first night. After 21 consecutive nights, 14 nights away before returning. Check-in 3:15 pm, check-out 2 pm.

note: Brown County park on the Niagara Escarpment along the east shore of the bay of Green Bay, ~15 mi NE of the city on WI-57; wooded loops with asphalt pads, a boat launch, hiking and biking trails, and a trail down the ledge to the beach. Wifi only near the playground. --Claude
summary: County camping page, 2026 map and per-site table confirm 107 sites (90 W/E with 50 A on 49-82, 15 rustic, 2 group), $34/$22, showers, laundry, dump; booking via WebTrac with 24 FCFS sites, weekend 2-night / holiday 3-night online minimums, 21-night limit; season April-October (2026 close Nov 1). Pin is at the day-use road west of the campground: move ~490 m. Note fixed (east shore, not west; site counts from an old listing removed). Possible coastal walk upgrade flagged.
flags: PIN MOVE ~490 m: stored 44.6353,-87.8031 sits on the park entrance road by the day-use field west of the campground; camping loops centre ~44.6356,-87.7969.

WATERFRONT (reviewer call): stored 'not waterfront' (not --AWH). Possible upgrade to coastal walk: Green Bay is Lake Michigan water; the loops' north edge is ~130 m from the shore through the park's own woods, with no road, highway or houses between (Esri imagery ~44.6372,-87.7975), the county map shows a 'Trail to Beach' and the park road reaches the boat launch/beach ~500-700 m from the loops. Caveat: the campground sits on the escarpment ~35 m above the water (DEM 213 m vs ~177 m lake level) and the map warns 'Caution: uneven trail surface along ledge'. No site is near the water, so no on-water value.
